title: A partial payment.
caption: Splitt · Project payment workspace
narration: A client pays part of an invoice. Your contractors are waiting, and your project still needs a reserve. Splitt turns that shortfall into a reviewed payment plan, with a reason behind every amount.

title: Protect the reserve first.
caption: Synthetic invoice: 2,000 USDC. Received: 1,200. Reserve: 300.
narration: This is our synthetic Northstar project. The invoice is two thousand USDC, but only twelve hundred arrived. Three hundred stays protected. That leaves nine hundred available for eligible contractor obligations. These demo amounts do not move real funds.

title: Pay what unlocks delivery.
caption: Amara: 700 USDC. Tobi: 200 USDC, with partial payment permitted.
narration: The allocation engine pays Amara's full seven hundred because her accepted work unlocks delivery. Tobi receives two hundred because his agreed terms allow a partial payment. The validator checks eligibility, reserve, caps, shortfall and supporting facts before owner review.

title: The owner keeps control.
caption: Fresh facts → validated proposal → exact signed batch → Circle execution
narration: In the live workspace, the owner reviews and signs the exact batch. The signature binds the project version, plan, ordered payments and expiry. Circle's operator executes it. A durable queue retains the original intent, and chain replay flags establish the outcome after a missing response.

title: Replan when cash arrives.
caption: The 800-USDC remainder unlocks only Tobi’s outstanding 300.
narration: Now the eight hundred USDC remainder arrives in our browser simulation. Splitt replans from the remaining obligations. Amara is already paid. Tobi receives only his outstanding three hundred. The earlier batch cannot be counted twice.

title: Each project keeps its cash.
caption: Simulated final state · No on-chain payout is implied
narration: Northstar finishes with both contractor obligations fully paid and eight hundred USDC remaining. Fieldwork's separate one thousand USDC balance stays untouched. Allocation never borrows one project's cash to satisfy another project's commitments.

title: Confirmed on Arc Testnet.
caption: Evidence checked 14 October 2026 · Public testnet transactions
narration: The real vault is deployed on Arc Testnet. Sourcify confirms exact matches for creation and runtime bytecode. Circle's operator has completed a verified contract query. That query transferred zero value and is not a contractor payout. The scaled payout proof is prepared.

title: Ready for the next proof.
caption: Draft walkthrough · Replace this segment after confirmed payouts and pilot use
narration: Contractors activate on October fifteenth at four eighteen PM Lagos. Real payouts, live model comparison and a consenting business pilot remain pending. The browser demo uses the deterministic engine. This draft shows the current build honestly; the final submission must include the completed evidence.
